newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan stock exchange pursues its upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan stock exchange pursues its upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca stock exchange closed its two hour-session on Monday 0.25 percent higher, lifted mainly by the market blue chips, stockbrokers said.
The all-share index closed at 477.73 points, up from 476.55 on Friday.
It had registered an increase of 6.84 percent since the beginning of the year, a bourse official said.
"The market is pursuing its upward trend on the upcoming results of the largest firms...Traders expect very positive results including those of ONA Group and its subsidiaries," a stockbroker said.
A Casablanca-based market analyst said the ONA group would show an estimated 800 million dirhams ($89.8 million) consolidated net profit for 1996 instead of 720 million dirhams expected earlier.
ONA, Morocco's largest private group which holds diversified stakes in more than 100 companies, was traded at 598 dirhams, up eight dirhams over Friday's session.
The banking sector blue chip Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, closed at 430 dirhams, up two on the previous session.
Leading brewery firm Brasseries du Maroc rose 10 dirhams to close at 1,750.
Societe Nationale d'Investissement, lost five dirhams to stabilise at 560.
Total traded volume on the official market was 63.6 million dirhams, up from 34.6 million on Friday.
